audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart is a blanket 'Skill' on all 7 rows; content win[] and packet levelChart both read Xerath/Xerath/Skill/Skill/Syndra/Syndra/Syndra. Two answers render to the user, and the full whys at rows 4-6 describe Xerath winning stages the content gives to Syndra.
audit.why: Content and packet agree exactly; the shift is kit-groundable — Xerath's charged Q (up to ~1400) outranges Dark Sphere (800) pre-3, while her 6/item spikes (stored-sphere Unleashed Power execute, E stun setup) out-burst a poke build.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-1 flipped to Xerath (whys already describe Xerath winning); rows 4-6 flipped to Syndra with whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Scatter the Weak's 15s flat cooldown and her R 120/100/80 never appear (COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT); the R-channel-cancelled-by-E interaction (missing interaction 'your-channel-punished') is unstated; 21 pronoun errors call Syndra he/his.
audit.why: Kit gives E 15s / 650 range and R 120s rank 1; Xerath R is an interruptible channel and her E is hardCC. Syndra is she/her per champ-gender.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field rewritten with numbers and the channel-cancel warning; all misgendered fields fixed in edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Resistances-invalidated missing interaction: her Transcendent-upgraded W deals bonus true damage, so stacking MR is a poor answer. Not stated anywhere.
